# Your first real analysis

No code in this part. Not one line.

That is not a warm-up decision. The tools in these chapters are the ones
working biologists reach for most days, they run in a browser, and people
publish papers on the strength of them. You can do real work before you can
program, and doing it first means that when the code arrives in Part 2 you will
already know what you want it to do.

By the end of this part you will have looked up a gene, identified an unknown
sequence, judged how much to believe the result, and found a protein structure
that nobody has ever seen under a microscope.
